BRAVE-TIGER.name: The ArmoredEmperorTigerDeity Brave-Tiger
BRAVE-TIGER.effect:
[Brave Condition: Red-only & Cost 4 or more]

[During Brave]
Neither player can gain cores from the Void though effects.

[During Brave] (When Attacks)
You can destroy an opposing Spirit/Ultimate with BP equal or inferior to this Spirit's, and effects of the destroyed Spirit/Ultimate cannot activate.

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A12545.name: The SkyHero Lord-Dragon-Bazzel
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A12545.effect:
[Burst: After your Life is reduced]
Summon this card without paying the cost.

[LV1][LV2][LV3] 1 (When Summoned/Attacks)
Heavy exhaust an opposing Spirit/Ultimate.
[heb]

[LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)
You can immediately activate one of your "Supreme Hero"/"Winged Beast" family Bursts. After that Burst activates, refresh this Spirit.

P16-06.name: The Summer Means Swimming With Everyone
P16-06.effect:
[LV1][LV2]
Between June 1st and August 31st, when your Blue Spirits are destroyed, discard a card from the opposing decktop, and when any Spirit card is discarded, those Spirits remain on the Field, exhausted.

[LV2]
The LV2 cost of all Blue Spirits you control becomes 2.

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A14035.name: Ultimate-Sagitto-Apollodragon-Epitaph
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A14035.effect:
[Summon Condition: You control one or more Blue Ultimates]

[Double Ultimate Trigger: [LV3][LV4][LV5] (When Attacks)]
For each Ultimate Trigger hit, destroy an opposing Spirit with the lowest cost.
[Double Hit] Also, when both Ultimate Triggers hit, give this Ultimate an extra Ultimate symbol.
[wutb]

[LV4][LV5] (When Attacks)
When this Ultimate's Double Ultimate Trigger double hits, refresh another Ultimate you control.
